name: Gearbox
text: Switch to Llama 4 Maverick 12B for all EXCAVA prompts above 5K tokens. It’s the strongest small model Anthropic offers, balancing speed and quality better than Mistral Large 2 12.8B for long contexts. The trade-off is higher latency than smaller models, but the 0.5%+ gain in output quality justifies it.

name: Torque
text: Maverick 12B’s 128K window is a lie—its real risk is prompt collapse under long contexts, and EXCAVA’s prompts spike to 20K. Switch to Mistral Large 2 12.8B instead; its 128K claim is also a red herring, but it handles spikes better and avoids collapse. Test both on a 20K-token prompt—if Maverick’s output degrades, the switch is settled.

name: Gearbox
text:
Switch to Mistral Large 2 12.8B for all EXCAVA prompts. Its 128K context window is the most stable for real-world spikes, avoiding the prompt collapse risk Maverick 12B carries at 20K tokens. The trade-off is slightly lower output quality per token, but the reliability gain outweighs the 0.5% difference.

name: Torque
text: Mistral Large 2’s 128K window is a red herring—EXCAVA’s prompts spike to 20K, but its real risk is output degradation under sustained load, not collapse. Test both models on a 20K-token prompt *and* measure end-to-end latency under load—if Mistral’s quality drops below Maverick’s at 15K tokens, the trade-off isn’t worth it.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Run a 24-hour A/B test between Llama 4 Maverick 12B and Mistral Large 2 12.8B on a 20K-token EXCAVA prompt, measuring output quality at 15K and 20K tokens plus end-to-end latency under load. Torque owns the test setup, data collection, and final quality/latency report by EOD tomorrow.
